2615 battles2615 场对战

Raw judge Elo and grounded evidence disagree sharply裸判官 Elo 与真实证据出现明显分歧

GPT-Researcher sits near the top by raw judge Elo (1147), but only 4.3% of its cited URLs resolve and 2.2% of quoted evidence is verified. The truth-gated board drops it to #11, while Claude Code and OpenCode lead because quality and evidence both hold up.GPT-Researcher 的裸判官 Elo 很高（1147），但引用可达率只有 4.3%，引文核实率只有 2.2%。真值门控榜将其降到第 11；Claude Code 与 OpenCode 领先，是因为报告质量与证据质量同时成立。

24 model tasks24 个模型任务

The minimal qwen3 baseline exposes the cost of citation pressure极简 qwen3 基线暴露了引用压力的代价

In the current model board, qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 runs under the fixed minimal protocol across 24 tasks and 643 clean judge battles. Its grounding gate is about 24%: many answers read coherently, but weak source budgets still push the model toward unreachable or unverifiable citations.在当前模型榜中，qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 使用固定极简协议，覆盖 24 个任务与 643 场 clean 判官对战。它的接地门约为 24%：不少回答读起来连贯，但来源预算不足仍会把模型推向不可达或无法核验的引用。

Fluent hallucination beats naive judges流畅的幻觉能骗过粗糙的评判

The prettiest report can still fabricate unreachable URLs. Composite v3.1 makes citation reachability a first-class ranking signal.再漂亮的报告也可能捏造无法访问的 URL。Composite v3.1 把引用可达性作为一等排名信号。

Dual judge双评判

Judge family changes the ordering评判模型家族会改变排序

A same-family judge inflates familiar answer styles. The benchmark separates agent and judge families to reduce self-preference.同家族的评判模型会高估自己熟悉的作答风格。本基准将智能体与评判模型的家族分离，以降低自我偏好。

+162 Elo+162 Elo

Adapter quality can beat framework reputation适配器质量可以胜过框架声誉

DeerFlow moved sharply after shim and backend fixes, showing that integration quality is part of real-world agent performance.DeerFlow 在修复适配层和后端后排名大幅上升，说明集成质量本身就是真实智能体性能的一部分。

RACERACE

Long answers are not necessarily grounded answers答案长并不等于答案有据可依

LLM judges often reward coverage and polish. URL-level verifiers reveal when length hides unsupported claims.LLM 评判往往奖励覆盖面与文字打磨。URL 级别的验证器能揭示长度何时掩盖了缺乏支撑的论断。

Open supporting context查看相关背景
ParetoPareto

Only a few agents are cost-quality efficient只有少数智能体在成本与质量上是高效的

The efficient frontier is small: most agents are dominated once quality, cost, and dropped runs are considered together.高效前沿很小：一旦同时考量质量、成本与丢弃的运行，大多数智能体都会被支配。

Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks. Fluency is not grounding.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。流畅不等于接地。
